title: Toolchain executable provenance matrix

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Production Insula evidence must account for executable identity, not just PATH lookup.
hypothesis: Every production-required executable should resolve to an absolute rootfs-owned path, carry version/hash evidence where readable, and avoid forbidden host or Nix prefixes in its ABI surface.
minimal_fixture: The selected Insula PATH and its production_required_tools list.
predicted_behavior: Production mode should show absolute rootfs-owned executable paths for Emacs, Python, Jupyter, LSP servers, C/C++ tools, and Rust tools.

independent_checks.name: provenance was captured for every required tool
production tools resolve to rootfs-owned executable paths
provenance has no forbidden host or Nix prefixes
